name: merge the most frequent adjacent pair into a new symbol
mechanism: count adjacent symbol pairs, replace every occurrence of the most frequent pair by a new symbol, record the merge, and repeat until no pair repeats or a vocabulary size is reached

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Byte pair encoding (BPE)' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Lossless compression algorithms:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'SEQUITUR algorithm': lossless compression by incremental grammar inference on a string

requires: a symbol alphabet that can grow
fails_when: the merge table must ship with the data
